metadata.question: Was the rainfall in Seattle between September through November in 2021 larger than that in 2020 and in 2019?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: Use CHIRPS daily precipitation (UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY). Location: Seattle point buffered 15 km. Dates: 2019-09-01 to 2019-12-01, 2020-09-01 to 2020-12-01, 2021-09-01 to 2021-12-01. 2. Masking strategy: No cloud masking (rainfall product). Use valid-pixel count to detect C2. 3. Logic: If any collection empty -> try ERA5-LAND/DAILY_AGGR as fallback. If still empty -> C1. If pixel count 0 -> C2. If any value None/NaN -> C3. Else compare totals; 2021 > 2020 and 2019 => A, else B. ```python import ee import math # Initialize Earth Engine try: ee.Initialize() except Exception: ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. Geometry & Time Definitions seattle = ee.Geometry.Point([-122.3321, 47.6062]).buffer(15000) # ~15 km buffer periods = { 2019: ('2019-09-01', '2019-12-01'), 2020: ('2020-09-01', '2020-12-01'), 2021: ('2021-09-01', '2021-12-01'), } scale_m = 5500 # ~CHIRPS native resolution def get_chirps_stats(start, end, geom): col = ee.ImageCollection('UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY') \ .filterDate(start, end) \ .filterBounds(geom) size = col.size().getInfo() if size == 0: return {'ok': False, 'reason': 'empty', 'source': 'CHIRPS', 'size': 0} sum_img = col.select('precipitation').sum() # Pixel count and mean total mm over the period count = sum_img.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=geom, scale=scale_m, maxPixels=1e9, ).get('precipitation').getInfo() if (count is None) or (int(count) == 0): return {'ok': False, 'reason': 'no_valid_pixels', 'source': 'CHIRPS', 'size': size} mean_mm = sum_img.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=geom, scale=scale_m, maxPixels=1e9, ).get('precipitation').getInfo() if (mean_mm is None) or (isinstance(mean_mm, float) and (math.isnan(mean_mm) or math.isinf(mean_mm))): return {'ok': False, 'reason': 'calc_fail', 'source': 'CHIRPS', 'size': size} return {'ok': True, 'size': size, 'count': int(count), 'total_mm': float(mean_mm), 'source': 'CHIRPS'} def get_era5_stats(start, end, geom): # Fallback: ERA5-Land daily aggregated total precipitation (meters), convert to mm. try: col = ee.ImageCollection('ECMWF/ERA5_LAND/DAILY_AGGR') \ .filterDate(start, end) \ .filterBounds(geom) size = col.size().getInfo() if size == 0: return {'ok': False, 'reason': 'empty', 'source': 'ERA5', 'size': 0} sum_img = col.select('total_precipitation_sum').sum() # meters over period count = sum_img.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=geom, scale=5000, maxPixels=1e9, ).get('total_precipitation_sum').getInfo() if (count is None) or (int(count) == 0): return {'ok': False, 'reason': 'no_valid_pixels', 'source': 'ERA5', 'size': size} mean_m = sum_img.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=geom, scale=5000, maxPixels=1e9, ).get('total_precipitation_sum').getInfo() if (mean_m is None) or (isinstance(mean_m, float) and (math.isnan(mean_m) or math.isinf(mean_m))): return {'ok': False, 'reason': 'calc_fail', 'source': 'ERA5', 'size': size} mean_mm = float(mean_m) * 1000.0 return {'ok': True, 'size': size, 'count': int(count), 'total_mm': mean_mm, 'source': 'ERA5'} except Exception: return {'ok': False, 'reason': 'error', 'source': 'ERA5', 'size': None} def get_period_total_mm(year, start, end, geom): # Try CHIRPS first res = get_chirps_stats(start, end, geom) if not res['ok']: if res['reason'] == 'empty': # Try fallback ERA5-Land daily aggregated res2 = get_era5_stats(start, end, geom) if not res2['ok']: return res2 # propagate failure return res2 else: return res return res try: results = {} for yr, (start, end) in periods.items(): stats = get_period_total_mm(yr, start, end, seattle) results[yr] = stats # Print concise evidence if stats.get('ok', False): print(f"{yr} Source: {stats['source']}, Images: {stats['size']}, Pixels: {stats['count']}, Total(mm): {stats['total_mm']:.1f}") else: reason = stats.get('reason', 'unknown') size = stats.get('size') print(f"{yr} Source: {stats.get('source')}, Issue: {reason}, Images: {size}") # Evaluate outcomes based on checks # Case C1: Empty collection for any year and fallback failed if any((not results[yr]['ok']) and (results[yr].get('reason') == 'empty') for yr in results): print("C1") # Case C2: No valid pixels after processing elif any((not results[yr]['ok']) and (results[yr].get('reason') == 'no_valid_pixels') for yr in results): print("C2") # Case C3: Calculation failure (None/NaN) elif any((not results[yr]['ok']) and (results[yr].get('reason') == 'calc_fail') for yr in results): print("C3") # Case D: Method/dataset error elif any((not results[yr]['ok']) and (results[yr].get('reason') in ['error']) for yr in results): print("D") else: v2019 = results[2019]['total_mm'] v2020 = results[2020]['total_mm'] v2021 = results[2021]['total_mm'] # Final comparison: Is 2021 > 2020 and 2019? if (v2021 is None) or (v2020 is None) or (v2019 is None) or \ any([math.isnan(v) or math.isinf(v) for v in [v2019, v2020, v2021]]): print("C3") elif (v2021 > v2020) and (v2021 > v2019): print("A") else: print("B") except Exception as e: # Any unexpected error print("D") ```
